title: Class-II gauge-horizontal source, joint source-potential reduction, and local Bellman obstruction
statement: For the hash-pinned A1 production coefficients and A10-A13 strict sharp cubes, exact Class-II algebra and independently executed fixtures close several invalid proof architectures without closing the Nelson theorem. The corrected factor-four allocation gives exponent cost 0.044555890186929 and margin 0.103944109813071. The candidate one-use inequality is exactly equivalent to the still-open q=10/9 Nelson moment, so Boue-Dupuis/HJB recasting alone is circular. A scalar loop refutes coefficient-blind endpoint-only timewise Young. For the nonfrozen determinant route, 2V=delta_gamma b and Db=T_X+K_X admit cutoff-uniform Schatten-two bounds, but the exact Class-II coefficient curl is nonzero. With the correct Ramer coefficient t=q/2=5/9, two independent production 30-real-mode calculations find a determinant sign change near amplitude 3.49230586; the direct Ramer square also costs 0.14136616176932618>0.135. Thus a one-shot global Ramer map is refuted. The umbrella one-use theorem remains the sole canonical gate; no unique successor method is claimed, and any continuation must preserve a signed global cancellation.
scope: PROVED-STRUCTURAL-REDUCTIONS-AND-EXECUTED-ARCHITECTURE-NOGOS@FIXED-FLOOR-SHARP-CUBE on L=16 for the A1 production symbol and coefficients, three complex components in the six-real convention, rho_regularizer=1e-12, exact Fourier products, the unit sharp regulator, and the A10-A13 dyadic rectangular-cube filtration. The Fierz, Gaussian, Hardy, coercivity, corrected allocation, exact one-use/Nelson equivalence, scoped scalar timewise no-go, nonfrozen Schatten-two decomposition, coefficient-curl identity, conditional Carleman-Fredholm theorem, and predictable triangular determinant boundary are analytic. The degree-65536 carrier and 30-real-mode Ramer singularity are independently reproduced floating evidence rather than interval proofs. The broad joint log-Laplace and one-use gates are reduced, not closed.
falsifier: A failure of the compact Fierz matrix, shell commutator, shifted-Gaussian identity, source-doubling fixtures, factor-four correction, exact one-use/Nelson equivalence, scalar loop polynomial, nonfrozen Schatten decomposition, coefficient-curl formula, corrected t=q/2 Ramer normalization, either production determinant sign-change route, Hilbert-Schmidt boundary fixture, source hashes, PDF QA, assertion count, or release gate falsifies this package.

reproduction.expected: Primary 54/54, non-importing independent 47/47, and integrated aggregate 158/158 pass; A13-CLASSII-JOINT-SOURCE-POTENTIAL-REDUCTION-INTEGRATED-PASS; exit 0.

no_overclaim: This claim does not prove the cutoff-uniform controlled-shell estimate, the equivalent q=10/9 Nelson moment, failure of every nonlinear Gaussian transport, the A11 stabilised theorem or A7 Nelson bound, a full joint log-Laplace bound, an interacting measure, absence of new interaction counterterms, floor or regulator removal, infinite volume, a phase transition or BCC selection, or T5, T6, or T7. The exact equivalence is a circularity diagnostic, and the Ramer singularity refutes only the one-shot u=(5/9)b map. Exact ODE, triangular/Follmer, alternative invertible transport, and direct constructive routes remain open.
next_action: Continue A13-CLASSII-CONTROLLED-SHELL-ENERGY-ONE-USE only through a signed global cancellation theorem, with a genuinely triangular/flow transport or direct constructive estimate as candidate methods. The proof must retain A9 Schatten-two cancellation and the positive-square resolvent rebate without separately paying the Ramer square and inverse determinant, spend Cameron-Martin energy once, and introduce no new interaction counterterm. Boue-Dupuis/HJB recasting, coefficient-one local conditioning, finite-bank Bellman repair, endpoint-only timewise Young, repeated past-energy payment, resolvent-only repair, and the one-shot u=(5/9)b Ramer map are forbidden.
